_doc: Event pool for the generator. kind = engine effect type. target picks the stage: manual (stage looks manual), automated (auto/semi), early (first half), any. {stage}, {unit}, {pct} are filled in. Add an entry to add an event; no code changes.

events.title: {unit} spike +{pct}%
events.text: A promotion landed. {unit} arrive {pct}% faster for a while.

events.title: Key person absent at {stage}
events.text: The one person who knows {stage} is out. Manual work there slows down.

events.title: New format at {stage}
events.text: A big customer changed their format. {stage} produces more errors and rework.

events.title: System outage at {stage}
events.text: {stage} is half down for a few seconds. Even automated steps have bad days.

events.title: Extra checks at {stage}
events.text: Compliance added a check at {stage}. Throughput drops until it settles.
